notes.evidence: Metastatic colorectal cancer. First-line FOLFOX produced a partial response. At follow-up four months later, imaging demonstrated new hepatic lesions consistent with progression. FOLFOX was discontinued for treatment failure; second-line therapy discussed.
Note A: Patient failed first-line FOLFOX after four cycles. Addendum same day: Disease remains responsive to FOLFOX; continue current regimen.

Stage IV colon adenocarcinoma. The patient initially improved on first-line FOLFOX with shrinking metastases. Several months afterward, restaging showed enlarging liver metastases and treatment was stopped because the regimen had failed; options for next-line therapy were reviewed.
Same-day note: first-line FOLFOX is documented as having failed after four cycles. Same-day addendum: the disease is still responding to FOLFOX and the current regimen should continue without change.

Metastatic NSCLC on first-line pembrolizumab plus carboplatin/pemetrexed. Early scans showed partial response. At the six-month restaging visit, imaging now shows progression of known lesions with new nodal disease. Plan: discontinue current first-line regimen and discuss second-line options.
Assessment: first-line pembrolizumab failed; switch therapy. Addendum recorded the same visit: disease remains responsive to pembrolizumab; do not change therapy.

Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. After three cycles of R-CHOP the nodes had responded. Later restaging demonstrated new sites of disease consistent with progression on R-CHOP; first-line therapy was abandoned for failure and salvage was planned.

Today's note states the patient progressed through first-line R-CHOP and should move to salvage. A same-day correction states excellent ongoing response to R-CHOP with plan to continue the identical regimen.

Metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma. First-line FOLFIRINOX yielded an initial radiographic response. On subsequent imaging months later, new peritoneal implants appeared; FOLFIRINOX was discontinued for treatment failure.
Chart: Patient failed first-line FOLFIRINOX after six cycles. Same-day addendum: disease remains sensitive to FOLFIRINOX; continue present therapy.
